name: Solar Photovoltaic Devices and Systems
description: Photovoltaic materials: fundamentals of semiconductors; physical, optical and electrical characterizations of absorber layers; role of microstructure (single crystal, multicrystalline, polycrystalline, amorphous, and nano-crystalline) in electrical and optical properties of the materials; design and fabrication of various solar cells; analysis of photovoltaic devices; integration of various PV technologies for system development; case studies of PV technologies and environmental impact.
